reference: Huber et al. 2011, ApJ, 743, 143; Chaplin et al. 2014, ApJS, 210, 1

provenance.source_kind: observed asteroseismic standard stars from Kepler and literature
provenance.independence: Observations from Kepler short-cadence asteroseismology (Chaplin et al. 2014 Table 1; Huber et al. 2011 Table 1). Expected mass and radius follow the direct seismic scaling equations relative to the IAU/nominal solar calibration.
provenance.limitations: These benchmarks evaluate fundamental global seismic scaling relations (numax, dnu, Teff). Detailed structural modeling requires individual oscillation frequencies (echelle diagrams and mode frequencies l=0,1,2).
